digest.title: AI staff 'genuinely frightened' for humanity's future, ex-Anthropic researcher tells BBC
digest.tldr: It comes as the AI firm's boss has called for the technology's development to be slowed down, citing "serious" risks.

digest.title: David Sacks: OpenAI and Anthropic Don't Need Regulations to Pace Frontier Models
OpenAI’s Sam Altman says it would be ‘ill-advised’ to go public in 2026
digest.tldr: While OpenAI has filed confidentially for an IPO, the company will not be going public this year, according to CEO Sam Altman.

digest.title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
digest.tldr: The call comes amid growing concerns that AI models may become able to inflict serious damage worldwide.

digest.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI tried to hack another company in May
digest.tldr: In May, hundreds of malicious and spam packages were uploaded to RubyGems, causing a serious disruption for the host.  Now independent researchers have said that a swarm of OpenAI agents were responsible for the attack.
